name: 北欧冷白
description: 北欧极简冷调：#F5F7FA 冷灰白 + #0EA5E9 冷蓝 + Inter sans + 超大留白。H1 小号 22px 左靠瘦字，H2 细线底，p 行距 2，整体呼吸感极大（vs swiss-grid 硬朗压字距派，本主题是纤细纤柔派）。适合极简生活/设计思考/产品评测/书摘。

styles.h1: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; color: #1E293B; line-height: 1.3; margin-top: 48px; margin-bottom: 30px; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
styles.h2: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #1E293B; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 40px; margin-bottom: 16px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #CBD5E1; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
styles.h3: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #0EA5E9; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 28px; margin-bottom: 12px;
styles.h4: font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #1E293B; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 10px;
styles.h5: font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #64748B; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.5;
styles.h6: font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: #94A3B8; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.p: font-size: 15px; color: #334155; line-height: 2; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 20px; letter-spacing: 0.1px;
styles.blockquote: background: #E0F2FE; border-left: 2px solid #0EA5E9; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; margin-top: 28px; margin-bottom: 28px; font-size: 14px; color: #475569; line-height: 1.85;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 14px; color: #475569; line-height: 1.85; margin-bottom: 0; background: transparent;
styles.a: color: #0EA5E9; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #0EA5E9; padding-bottom: 1px;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; display: block; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 24px; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent;
styles.hr: margin-top: 44px; margin-bottom: 44px; height: 1px; border: none; background: #CBD5E1;
styles.code: background: #E2E8F0; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 88%; color: #0EA5E9; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono','SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;
styles.pre: background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 4px; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #1E293B; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.7; white-space: pre-wrap;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 30px; background: #F1F5F9; color: #64748B; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1px;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #1E293B; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono','SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 22px; font-size: 13px;
styles.th: text-align: left; font-weight: 600; color: #1E293B; background: #F1F5F9; border-bottom: 1px solid #CBD5E1; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.li: font-size: 15px; color: #334155; line-height: 2; display: flex; margin-bottom: 8px; align-items: flex-start;
